title: The Impact of Exchange-Traded Fund Index Inclusion on Stock Prices
authors: John Fitzgerald Duffy; Daniel Friedman; Jean Paul Rabanal; Olga A. Rud
eligible_reason: Laboratory asset-market experiment with three between-session treatments (ABC, A2C, A2C with short selling). Treatment is assigned at the session level and constant within session; no staggered adoption, no unit and calendar-time fixed-effects DiD.
design_notes: oTree continuous double auction sessions; comparisons of prices, index premia and order-book measures across treatments (nonparametric tests and figures in R). Regression inventory is empty; no panel DiD code.
data_files_note: Raw oTree trade, order and session output for all sessions plus cleaned Rda files.
screener_notes: Published PDF text read (data/text/mnsc/mnsc.2022.02125.txt); abstract confirms a laboratory experiment.
